relationships.subject: RRx-001
relationships.evidence_quote: RRx-001 is a small molecule NLRP3 inflammasome inhibitor with anti-CD47 and antiangiogenic/vascular normalization properties in a Phase 3 clinical trial that has been designated as a drug-device combination by the FDA.

relationships.subject: RRx-001
relationships.evidence_quote: In mid and high RRx-001-treated groups, at the dosing site, increased incidence and severity of subacute inflammation and increased incidence of chronic thrombi were present.

relationships.subject: RRx-001
relationships.evidence_quote: on the premise that binding of RRx-001 to hemoglobin 6 in the device would render it unable to directly elicit venous pain and irritation in vivo

key_findings: Direct weekly IV RRx-001 for 13 weeks in rats caused subacute vein-wall inflammation and thrombi at the injection site, partly resolving after 28 days.
Co-administration with autologous blood is preferred over direct IV infusion because of infusion phlebitis.
